before_any_future_association: Name a new protocol/population version explicitly; retain phase25/26 frozen versions and negative or insufficient outcomes.

Complete documentary glyph localization and physical-leaf mapping for any proposed additions. Keep multiword, uncertain and conflicting sources explicit; never select a reading using image similarity.
Define eligible connected motif units and record all alternatives before feature coding. Shared networks, repeated views, r/v faces, panels and f85/f86 composite do not multiply independent leaves.
Fix any new feature profile and layout rule without consulting an association score. No lowering of phase25 gates to rescue the sample.
Obtain actual sealed outside-human annotations if claiming independent review. Existing blank packets are preparation, not validation; do not send automatically.
Establish actual observable feature coverage, duplicate-object exclusions and all unchanged structural gates. Optimistic upper bounds cannot grant GO.
Freeze sources, geometry, annotations, code and feasibility decision before any new association. Current mandate does not authorize that experiment.
current_allowed_completion: Inventory, source audit, pixel checks, independent combinatorial counting, documentation, local archival delivery only.
forbidden_shortcuts: No retuning attachments, variants or bands for a better score.
No treating previous reserves or same-operator reinspection as independent validation.
No interpreting feasibility or geometric attachment as translation.
No automatic publication, push, deployment or external message.
